blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Chemical language models (CLMs) are pretrained on large corpora of molecules with the aim of learning representations that transfer to diverse downstream tasks. Here, we systematically study the effects of pretraining using a series of such CLMs across 64 molecular property prediction datasets. We find that the downstream gains of pretraining in CLMs do not scale and performance saturates below gradient-boosting baselines. Across the regimes evaluated, only supervised pretraining on traditional physico-chemical descriptors consistently improves downstream performance for the CLMs tested whereas some forms of pretraining result in models worse than a randomly initialized encoder. While models can resolve molecular structure well, they do so no better than a randomly initialized model, suggesting that, at best, CLMs learn descriptor-like properties in addition to low-level token statistics during pretraining, but surprisingly little chemistry beyond what classical molecular features already capture.
blocks.zh: 化学语言模型(CLMs)被预先训练于分子的大型子体上,目的是学习向多种下游任务转移的表达. 在这里,我们系统研究了使用一系列这类CLM在64个分子属性预测数据集中进行预训的效果. 我们发现,人工智能预训的下游收益在梯度-起动基线下没有规模和性能饱和度。 在整个被评价制度中,只有受监督的传统物理化学说明书的预训才能不断提高所测试的CLM的下游性能,而某些形式的预训则导致模型比随机初始编码器更糟糕。 虽然模型可以很好地解决分子结构,但是它们做的并不比随机初始化模型更好,说明CLMs除了在预训期间学习低等符号统计之外,最多还能学习像描述器一样的特性,但除了古典分子特征已经捕捉到的化学特征之外,令人惊讶的是几乎没有什么化学特征.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The pretraining of models on a diverse corpus before adapting them to a downstream task of interest by fine-tuning has been a key paradigm in the development of modern machine learning. The pretraining paradigm naturally motivates the training of very large foundation models that often outperform specialist models, which only see data from the specific task they are evaluated on [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . The benefits of pretraining are generally understood to arise from the acquisition of reusable structure from the underlying domain. In natural language, pretraining has been shown to produce representations that encode linguistic structure, including parts of speech, syntax, and semantic information [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . Similarly, vision models learn to encode semantic and object-level structure despite receiving no corresponding labels [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 在通过微调使模型适应下游感兴趣的任务之前,对模型进行关于多样化实体的预先培训,一直是发展现代机器学习的关键范例。 预训范式自然激发了非常大的基础模型的培训,这些模型往往比专家模型要好,而专家模型只看到在[1,2,3]上评价的具体任务中的数据. 一般认为,预训的好处来自从基础领域获取可重复使用的结构。 在自然语言中,预训被显示可以产生编码语言结构的表示,包括部分语音,语法,和语义信息[4,5,6]. 同样,尽管没有收到相应的标签,视觉模型仍然学会编码语义和对象级结构[7].

blocks.en: Given its success in other domains, the pretraining paradigm has also been applied to chemistry. Treating molecules as objects for machine learning requires them to be converted into suitable mathematical representations, which can be done via hand-crafted rules, notably descriptors, which are computed values describing specific molecular properties [ 8 , 9 ] , through molecular fingerprints [ 10 , 11 ] , or, increasingly, by using the embeddings of machine learning models [ 12 , 13 ] . One common class of such models is trained analogously to language models, where instead of taking text as input these models are trained on molecules formatted as strings using SMILES [ 14 ] . Models can be trained fully unsupervised (i.e., using only unlabeled data) by making use of masked language modeling (MLM) [ 2 ] , where the model is tasked with filling in missing tokens in a string. We refer to this type of model as a “chemical language model (CLM)”, which is equivalent to another commonly used term, “molecular language models”, with the advantage of a more distinct acronym. A CLM is trained on molecular data alone (i.e., structures and optionally molecular properties) as opposed to LLMs that are fine-tuned or entirely trained on natural language corpora on the subject of chemistry (such as scientific literature, patents or experimental records) [ 15 ] or general-purpose LLMs used for chemical tasks [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 由于在其他领域取得了成功,预训范式也被应用于化学. 将分子作为机器学习对象需要将其转化为适当的数学表示,这可以通过手工制作的规则,特别是描述符来完成,这些描述符是描述特定分子属性的计算值[8,9],通过分子指纹[10,11],或者越来越多地使用机器学习模型的嵌入[12,13]. 这类模型的一个常见类别与语言模型类似,在这些模型中,使用SMILES[14]对以字符串格式编排的分子进行了培训,而不是将文字作为输入。 模型可以通过使用蒙面语言模型(MLM)[2]进行完全无监督的训练(即只使用无标签数据)[2],其中模型的任务是在字符串中填充缺失的符号. 我们把这种模型称为“化学语言模型”(CLM),相当于另一个常用的术语,即“分子语言模型”,其优点是有一个更为明显的缩写。 单就分子数据(即结构和可选择的分子性质)而仅就化学主题(如科学文献、专利或实验记录)或用于化学任务的通用LLM对LLM进行微调或完全进行自然语言Corpora培训。

blocks.en: In this work, we focus on the use of CLMs for molecular property prediction, where a model is tasked with predicting a property such as solubility, biological activity, or quantum-mechanical energy. We ask: does pretraining produce representations that encode chemically relevant information transferable to such downstream tasks? We illuminate this question from three perspectives: whether pretraining improves downstream prediction and continues to improve with the amount of pretraining data; whether these gains depend on chemically meaningful relationships in the pretraining data; and whether the resulting representations contain information beyond established molecular features and resolve chemically meaningful changes in molecular structure.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们专注于使用CLMs进行分子属性预测,其中一个模型的任务是预测溶解性,生物活性,或量子力学能量等属性. 我们问:预先培训是否产生可编码与化学有关的资料的表述,以便可转让给这些下游任务? 我们从三个角度阐明了这一问题:预训是否改进了下游预测,并随着预训数据数量的增加而继续改进;这些收益是否取决于预训数据中具有化学意义的关系;由此产生的表述是否包含超出既定分子特征的信息,并解决分子结构中具有化学意义的变化.

blocks.en: Prior work has produced mixed evidence that pretraining improves molecular property prediction. For GNNs, Sun, Dai, and Yu [ 17 ] found substantially larger gains from supervised than unsupervised pretraining, with weak scaling in unlabeled data and little benefit when relevant descriptors were available. Similar results have emerged for CLMs: MoLFormer showed no clear downstream scaling with pretraining dataset size [ 18 ] , while ChemBERTa-2 found supervised multi-task regression (MTR) generally superior to MLM and that improved pretraining loss did not reliably translate to downstream gains [ 19 ] . Sultan et al. found combined MLM+MTR optimal but still below downstream-trained tree models [ 20 ] , while Sagawa and Kojima found that downstream performance resists improvement even as pretraining loss scales with model and dataset size as well as compute [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 以前的工作产生了混合的证据,即预训可以改善分子属性预测. 对于GNNs,Sun,Dai,和Yu[17]发现,从监督前培训得到的收益远远大于未经监督的预培训,在未贴标签的数据中缩放得微弱,在有相关描述词的情况下,受益甚微. CLM也出现了类似的结果: MoLFormer没有显示具有预训数据集大小的下游明显缩放[18],而Chemberta-2发现受监督的多任务回归(MTR)一般优于MLM,改进的预训损失并不能可靠地转化为下游收益[19]. 苏尔坦等人. 发现组合的 MLM+MTR 最佳但仍然低于下游训练的树型[20],而佐川和小岛发现,即使有模型和数据集尺寸的预训练损失尺度以及计算[21],下游的性能也难以改善.

blocks.en:
Another line of work has asked what molecular information CLMs acquire during pretraining. Probing and interpretability studies have found evidence that pretrained representations encode aspects of molecular syntax, substructures, and property-relevant features [ 18 , 22 ] .
Karnysheva et al. [ 23 ] found that molecular substructures relevant for a downstream task undergo larger representational changes during fine-tuning than less relevant ones, but leave open whether this results in improved downstream property prediction. Interestingly, even randomly initialized models already encoded the basic motif of ring structures.
blocks.zh:
另一行工作则询问在预训期间,分子分子材料获得什么。 探险和可解释性研究发现,有证据表明,分子语法,子结构以及属性相关特征的预修表达法方面[18,22].
Karnysheva等人[23]发现,与下游任务相关的分子亚结构在微调时比不太相关的分子亚结构发生更大的代表变化,但对于这是否导致下游属性预测的改善,留有余地. 有趣的是,即使是随机初始化的模型已经编码了环状结构的基本动机.

blocks.en: Our work connects these two lines of research by asking not only whether pretraining improves molecular property prediction, but what information is responsible for any resulting improvement. Across systematic supervised and unsupervised pretraining experiments, we test how downstream performance changes with pretraining dataset size, molecular and task similarity, and across control experiments where we pretrain on increasingly perturbed input data to isolate what information is required for successful pretraining. We further investigate whether the resulting representations contain information beyond established molecular fingerprints and descriptors and whether they resolve chemically meaningful changes in molecular structure. Together, our experiments provide tests of whether the benefits of molecular pretraining can be attributed to learning transferable chemical information.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作将这两条研究线联系起来,不仅询问预训是否改进了分子属性预测,而且询问哪些信息对由此产生的改进负有责任. 在系统、有监督且无监督的预训实验中,我们测试下游的性能如何随着预训数据集的大小、分子和任务相似性而变化,以及在控制实验中测试我们如何预先掌握日益扰动的输入数据,以隔离成功预训所需要的信息。 我们进一步调查由此产生的表述是否包含超过既定分子指纹和描述符的信息,以及它们是否解决了分子结构中具有化学意义的变化。 我们的实验共同提供测试 分子预训的好处 能否归因于学习可转移的化学信息。

blocks.en: 2 Results
blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: A foundation model in chemistry should generate informative embeddings of molecules that only require the fine-tuning of small prediction heads, such as a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) for property prediction. In chemistry, we are privileged to have access to a fast, robust, and powerful alternative to such embeddings by using fingerprints, optionally supplemented with physico-chemical descriptors. We thus benchmark our CLM series of models, referred to as C hemical L anguage I nference with M odern B ERT (CLIMB), against these baseline encodings as input to XGBoost [ 24 ] , a gradient boosting algorithm that is generally considered a very strong baseline. We evaluated these models on a total of 64 datasets using three independent model seeds evaluated on five-fold cross-validation on each dataset. We report performance split among four main types of tasks: classification and regression, as well as activity cliffs (where a small structural change has a large property-level effect) and virtual screenings (which are large, heavily skewed classification problems, where few actives must be found among many inactive molecules). A list of the datasets used can be found in SI section A.3 . We trained most CLIMB models on a corpus of 8M molecules which allowed us to train more models, including the three seed replicates. We also include the results for two scaled-up models pretrained on 100M unique molecules which, due to compute limitations, only have one seed each.
blocks.zh: 化学中的基础模型应生成只要求微调小预测头的分子信息嵌入,如用于属性预测的多层透视(MLP). 在化学方面,我们有幸能够使用指纹,通过物理化学描述符来替代这种嵌入的快速、有力和强大的方法。 因此,我们参照这些基线编码作为XGBoost [24] 的输入,将我们的CLM系列模型(称为C hemical L anguage I forference with Modern B ERT (CLIMB))作为基准,这种梯度增强算法一般被认为是非常强的基准. 我们在总共64个数据集上对这些模型进行了评估,这些数据集使用每个数据集上经过五倍交叉验证评估的3个独立模型种子. 我们报告业绩分为四大类任务:分类和回归,以及活动悬崖(其中小结构变化具有较大的属性级效应)和虚拟筛选(这些是很大的,严重扭曲的分类问题,许多不活跃分子中必须找到的活性分子很少). 使用的数据集列表可见于SI A.3 节. 我们训练了大多数CLIMB模型 有关8M分子的体积 使我们能够训练更多的模型, 包括三个种子复制。 我们还包括两个在100M独有分子上预先训练的扩大模型的结果,由于计算限制,每个分子只有一个种子。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overall benchmarking performance. Mean rank across 64 datasets grouped into four task families. ( ∗ * ) All CLIMB models use three seeds, except the 100M models at one seed.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 总体基准业绩。 分为四个任务组的64个数据集的平均排名。 (* * * ) 所有CLIMB模型都使用三个种子,除了一个种子的100M模型.

blocks.en:
The CLIMB models cover a surprisingly wide range of performance and some do not even beat a randomly initialized, untrained encoder, see Figure 1 . Across datasets, pretraining on 217 RDKit [ 25 ] descriptors is by far the most successful pretraining strategy for CLIMB.
We also trained models on experimental assay and transcriptomic labels drawn from the LargeMix collection [ 26 ] —PCBA bioactivity and LINCS L1000 gene-expression profiles—datasets also used in training MiniMol, a successful GNN foundation model [ 27 ] . These data are experimentally measured rather than computed and their coverage is highly incomplete (a median PCBA molecule carries 10 of 1,328 assay labels) and often sparse, where a few rare active molecules are crowded by many inactives. This “sparse” pretraining resulted in an exceptionally bad model, worse than a random encoder. Mixed in with dense descriptor data, performance increases, although not substantially so. Pretraining on unlabeled data followed by supervised pretraining did not improve downstream performance. Surprisingly, even the reverse, where we pretrained on labeled data first and then on unsupervised SMILES, while not improving on descriptor pretraining, did conserve its benefits.
blocks.zh:
CLIMB模型覆盖了令人惊讶的广泛性能,有些甚至没有击败随机初始化,未经训练的编码器,见图1. 在整个数据集中,217 RDKit [25] 描述符的预训是迄今为止CLIMB最成功的预训策略.
我们还培训了从大混合体集合[26]-PCBA生物活性及LINCS L1000基因表达剖面图中抽取的实验测定和转录标签的模型——数据集也用于培训MiniMol,一种成功的GNN基础模型[27]. 这些数据是试验性地测量的,而不是计算出来的,其覆盖范围非常不完整(一个中位的PCBA分子携带了1,328个化验标签中的10个),而且往往很稀少,其中少数稀有活性分子被许多不活动分子挤压. 这种“sparse”预训导致一种异常糟糕的模型,比随机编码器更糟糕。 与密集的描述数据混合在一起,性能增加,尽管没有大幅度提高。 对无标签数据的预先培训以及监督的预先培训没有改善下游的业绩。 令人惊讶的是,甚至相反的是,我们先对标注的数据进行预先培训,然后对无监督的SMILES进行预先培训,虽然在描述性前培训方面没有改进,但确实保留了它的好处。

blocks.en: Pure unsupervised training did lead to some performance gains over a random encoder. We included unsupervised pretraining in our further experiments to better understand what this model learns during pretraining. While the 8M models generally have not yet plateaued in downstream performance, they do retain their relative ranking. We were relieved to see that our two scaled-up models, pretrained on 100M molecules, perform competitively with three previously reported CLMs: MoLFormer [ 18 ] , a large model pretrained on unlabeled data only; ChemBERTa-2 [ 19 ] , a model pretrained on descriptors; and SELFIES-TED [ 28 ] , a CLM using SELFIES [ 29 ] instead of SMILES as input. We did also evaluate our best models in an end-to-end setting, where the loss from a downstream task propagates through the entire model, not just the prediction head, but found no improvements in performance, see SI section E .
blocks.zh: 纯无监督的训练的确比随机编码器取得了一定的性能收益. 我们在进一步的实验中包括了不受监督的预训,以更好地理解这个模型在预训期间学到了什么. 虽然8M型机车在下游性能上一般还没有升级,但它们确实保留了相对的排名. 我们感到宽慰的是,我们的两个扩大型号,预先在100M分子上训练,以三个以前报告的CLM进行竞争: MoLFormer [18],一个大型型号只预先在无标签数据上训练; ChemBERTa-2 [19],一个模型预先在描述器上训练; SELFIES-TED [28],一个使用SELFIES [29] 而不是SMILES作为输入的CLM。 我们还在端到端的环境下评估了我们的最佳模型,其中下游任务的损失通过整个模型传播,不仅仅是预测头,也没有发现性能的改善,见SI E节。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Pretraining scaling. Downstream performance as a function of pretraining tokens processed. Pretraining is enlarged by sampling more unique molecules from the corpus with all other settings staying constant.
blocks.zh: 图 2:预训缩放. 下游性能作为预训令牌处理功能. 通过取样所有其它环境保持不变的更独特的分子来扩大预训。

blocks.en: However, the baseline XGBoost models dominated on virtually all datasets. These models, using the standard ECFP4 Morgan-fingerprint format [ 11 ] in addition to the 217 RDKit descriptors [ 25 ] , have the best overall and also the most consistent performance across the 64 datasets evaluated. In many cases, the absolute gap in performance is striking, particularly on regression and activity cliff tasks, see SI Figure C.1 . This cannot be said for XGBoost models using only fingerprints as input, which tend to be competitive on bioassay tasks like CBS or MoleculeACE while underperforming on datasets that heavily correlate with descriptors: ESOL and lipophilicity are two such tasks where performance quickly saturates using just a small number of descriptors.
blocks.zh: 然而,几乎所有数据集都以基线XGBoost模型为主。 这些模型除了使用217个RDKit描述符[25]外,还使用标准的ECFP4摩根指印格式[11],在评价的64个数据集中总体性能最好,也最一致. 在许多情况下,业绩的绝对差距是惊人的,特别是在回归和活动悬崖任务方面,见SI图C.1。 XGBoost模型仅使用指纹作为输入,在CBS或MoleculeACE等生物测定任务上往往具有竞争力,而在与描述符密切相关的数据集上则表现不佳,这不能说: ESOL和lipophilicity是两种这样的任务,性能使用少量的描述符快速饱和.

blocks.en: Even scaling up our pretraining efforts did not make our models competitive with this much simpler and faster baseline. As Figure 2 shows, scaling three CLIMB pretraining strategies—unsupervised, descriptor, and sequential pretraining—to 100M unique molecules while keeping model size fixed does not universally lead to performance gains on six representative tasks. While improvements occur, they tend to plateau early and at best approach the XGBoost baseline, as for Tox21. We find no robust and predictable downstream improvement with pretraining scale. This saturation could reflect limited model capacity or the fact that the additional molecules shown are irrelevant to downstream tasks. Regardless, our results suggest that the transferable information acquired during both supervised and unsupervised pretraining saturates relatively early and does not universally approach the performance of classical baselines.
blocks.zh: 即使扩大我们的培训前努力,也未能使我们的模型与这种简单和快捷的基线具有竞争力。 如图2所示,将3个CMIMB预训战略(无监督、描述和顺序预训)缩放到100M独有分子,同时保持模型大小固定,并不能普遍导致六项代表性任务的绩效提高。 虽然情况有所改善,但它们往往会提前达到XGBoost基线,最多接近Tox21基线。 我们发现,在培训前规模上,下游没有强劲和可预测的改进。 这种饱和状态可能反映模型容量有限或者所显示的额外分子与下游任务无关. 无论如何,我们的结果表明,在监督和非监督的预先训练期间获得的可转让信息相对较早,而且没有普遍接近经典基线的绩效。

blocks.en: Plausibly, downstream performance could be limited by the chemical space covered during pretraining. If so, models should perform better on molecules more similar to those seen during pretraining. We find little evidence for this, for either supervised or unsupervised pretraining (Figures 3 a,b). Performance is largely independent of corpus similarity, measured by fingerprint Tanimoto similarity between downstream molecules and the pretraining corpus; the gains observed do not appear significant relative to noise. Evaluating on more corpus-dissimilar molecules provides a soft proxy for out-of-domain generalization, where less similar molecules should be more challenging if the model learned specificities of its pretraining chemical space.
blocks.zh: 在预训期间覆盖的化学空间可以限制下游的明显性能。 如果是这样,模型在分子上的性能应比在预训期间看到的更相似。 我们没有找到任何证据来证明这一点,无论是在监督下还是在没有监督下进行预先训练(图3a,b)。 性能基本上独立于实体的相似性,用下游分子和预试体之间的指纹Tanimoto相似性来衡量;所观察到的收益与噪音相比似乎并不显著. 对更多实体-异分子的评价为域外泛化提供了一个软的代名词,如果模型了解其预先训练的化学空间的特殊性,那么在域外泛化中,较少相似的分子应该更具挑战性.

blocks.en:
Overall, similarity between pretraining and downstream tasks is not predictive of transfer. Reasonably, a model pretrained on labeled data could be expected to perform better on similar downstream tasks. We find no such evidence: Surprisingly, when comparing descriptor to bioassay pretraining, descriptor-based pretraining wins on both smooth, descriptor-like tasks as well as on bioassay-like downstream datasets with the gap in performance actually widening on the latter.
Figure 3 c shows that descriptor pretraining is consistently helpful, while other transfer patterns are less intuitive. For example, PCBA, a bioassay classification task, transfers best to the toxicity task Tox21, while PCQM, a quantum-mechanical regression task, transfers best to the sparse HIV virtual screen. We interpret this as descriptor pretraining teaching the model real, physico-chemical information during pretraining. Plausibly, the smooth distribution of descriptor labels might be a more useful training signal compared to the sparse, incomplete bioassay datasets. We test this by pretraining on a version of the descriptor corpus, where descriptors are randomly shuffled across molecules.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,培训前任务和下游任务之间的相似性无法预测转移。 有理由说,在标注数据上预先培训的模型可望在类似的下游任务中更好地发挥作用。 我们没有发现这样的证据: 令人惊讶的是,在将描述符与生物分析预训进行比较时,基于描述符的预训在平滑、描述符式的任务和生物分析式的下游数据集上获胜,而后者的实际性能差距却在扩大。
图3c显示,描述语前训练一直很有帮助,而其他转移模式则不太直观. 例如,PCBA是一种生物测定分类任务,它最好地转移到毒性任务Tox21,而PCQM是一种量子-机械回归任务,它最好地转移到稀少的艾滋病毒虚拟屏幕。 我们把它理解为在预训中教授模型真实的物理化学信息的描述性预训. 与稀疏、不完整的生物测定数据集相比,描述标签的平稳分布可能是一种更有用的培训信号。 我们通过对描述书的版本进行预先训练来测试, 描述书会随机地在分子之间洗涤。

(b) Lift over a random encoder relative to the average nearest-neighbor distances across pretraining and downstream molecules. blocks.en: Ideally, the pretraining of CLMs teaches generalizable, chemical concepts that can be usefully transferred to downstream tasks. To test this, we first used a corrupted pretraining target on our model pretrained on descriptor data, where we swapped descriptor values at random across the dataset, see Figure 4 a. Crucially, this does not change the marginal distribution of any descriptor but rather removes the linkage between molecular structure and its series of physico-chemical properties. This indeed led to a catastrophic loss of performance, where the model now underperforms even a random encoder. Seemingly, the model does learn a mapping between the structure of a molecule and its descriptors that goes beyond simply memorizing the distribution of labels. Indeed, the descriptors of a molecule can be predicted using a simple ridge head from the embeddings of the descriptor-pretrained model with a median R 2 R^{2} of 0.82, whereas both the unsupervised (0.59) and random (0.34) variants perform substantially worse, see SI Table D.1 . We consider this convincing evidence that supervised pretraining does reorganize a CLM’s latent space along exactly these physico-chemical properties.
blocks.zh: 理想的情况是,CLMs的预训会教授一般的,化学的概念,这些概念可以有益地转移到下游的任务. 为了测试这一点,我们首先在我们的模型上使用一个已损坏的预训目标,在描述器数据上进行预训,我们随机在数据集间交换描述器值,参见图4 a. 关键是,这并不改变任何描述符的边际分布,而是消除分子结构与其系列物理化学性质之间的联系. 这确实导致了灾难性的性能损失,现在的模型甚至连随机编码器都表现不佳. 似乎,该模型确实在分子的结构及其描述符之间学习了一种映射,它超越了简单的记忆标签的分布. 实际上,分子的描述符可以用一个简单的脊头从描述符预留模型的嵌入中位数R 2 R^{2}0.82来预测,而无监督的(0.59)和随机的(0.34)变体的性能则要差得多,见SI表D.1。 我们认为,有监督的预训确实按照这些物理-化学特性,重新组织一个CLM的潜在空间。

blocks.en: A very different story emerges when corrupting the unsupervised pretraining corpus. A priori , only filling in missing tokens in a SMILES string should not teach a model much chemistry beyond some low-level statistics of the corpus itself. Here, we use a series of perturbations to figure out what low-level statistics the model might be learning during pretraining. Firstly, we shuffle the tokens within a SMILES string while maintaining the co-occurrence of these tokens within a molecule. We then use bigram sampling, which keeps the frequency of local adjacencies of tokens intact, but alters which tokens occur in a molecule, as well as unigram sampling, where we sample tokens from the corpus marginal, i.e., the individual token frequencies. As an example of an entirely non-chemical corpus, we also tokenize English natural-language Wikipedia articles [ 30 ] using the same tokenizer we use for all CLIMB models. All methods, including the Wikipedia sampling, maintain the sequence length distribution of SMILES relative to the original corpus. We were astonished to see how much of the benefit of unsupervised pretraining can be recovered by pretraining on Wikipedia texts, particularly on the MoleculeACE and HIV tasks.
blocks.zh: 一个非常不同的故事出现 在腐败 不受监督的预训。 首先,只填入一个 SMILES 字符串中的缺失符号 , 不应该教一个模型的化学量超出 某些低水平 的 指令本身 。 在这里,我们用一系列的扰动来了解这个模型在预训期间可能学到的低级统计数据. 首先,我们在SMILES字符串中洗涤这些符号,同时保持这些符号在分子内的共同存在. 然后,我们使用Bigram取样, 它保持了本地附物的频率 保持完好, 但改变哪个附物发生在分子中, 以及单格抽样, 我们从实体边端,即单个附物频率, 取样。 作为完全非化学化身的例子,我们还将英语自然语维基百科的文章[30] 使用我们对所有CLIMB模型使用的同样的标语标语. 包括维基百科采样在内的所有方法都保持了SMILES相对于原物的序列长度分布. 我们惊讶地看到,通过对维基百科文本的预训,尤其是关于分子ACE和HIV任务的培训,可以恢复不受监督的预训的多少好处。

blocks.en: We find evidence for three separable mechanisms at play during unsupervised pretraining, see Figure 4 . Firstly, unsupervised pretraining leads to a better initialized model. We isolate the effect of better initialized weights after unsupervised pretraining by sampling the mean and variance of weights from a pretrained model without training on any data, see SI Section J . We find that better initialization accounts for between 8–28% (and 100% in the case of QM7) of the gain seen in unsupervised pretraining. Secondly, we do find evidence that our model learns low-level statistics on token adjacencies and per-molecule co-occurrences as both the bigram and shuffled-tokens experiments lead to some improvement over just weight conditioning, particularly on HIV and MoleculeACE. Lastly, we find that some results only arise when training on real SMILES, particularly BACE and Tox21, where the actual order of tokens in a SMILES seems to matter as well. In summary, we find that unsupervised pretraining acts both through improved initialization of weights as well as through learning low-level statistics on the pretraining corpus, although these mechanisms do not necessarily require real chemical data.
blocks.zh: 在未接受监督的预训期间,我们发现了三种可分离机制的证据,见图4。 首先,未经监督的预训导致更好的初始化模式。 在未经监督的预先训练后,我们通过对未经任何数据培训的预先训练模型中加权的平均值和差异进行取样,来分离出更好的初始加权效应,见SI J节。 我们发现,更好的初始化在无监督的预训中所见收益中占8-28%(在QM7的情况下占100%)。 第二,我们确实找到证据表明,我们的模型学习了有关象征性附着物和每分子共发物的低水平统计数据,因为大鼠标和摇晃的托盘实验导致一些改善,而不只是重量的调节,特别是在艾滋病毒和分子ACE方面。 最后,我们发现,只有在关于真正的SMILES的培训,特别是BACE和Tox21的培训时,才会产生一些结果,因为SMILES中的实际标志顺序似乎也很重要。 简言之,我们发现,未经监督的预先培训不仅通过改进权重的初始化,而且还通过学习关于预先培训的低水平统计数据,尽管这些机制不一定需要真正的化学数据。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Corrupted pretraining objectives. Downstream lift defined as performance gains over a random encoder after corrupting supervised molecule-descriptor mappings (a) or progressively removing chemical structure from the unsupervised corpus (b).
blocks.zh: 图4:被腐蚀的培训前目标。 下游升降机的定义是,在对受监督的分子描述器绘图(a)进行腐蚀或逐步从无监督的体(b)中去除化学结构后,对随机编码器的性能收益。

blocks.en: To see whether our CLIMB embeddings carry any supplementary information relative to fingerprints and descriptors, we tested what concatenating our embeddings adds in performance relative to using fingerprints, descriptors, or the combination of both. All combinations are fed into the same XGBoost prediction head with five-fold cross-validation. Figure 5 shows that CLIMB embeddings are generally not very helpful for these downstream tasks. In no case does adding the CLIMB embeddings improve performance over fingerprints+descriptors, suggesting that CLIMB embeddings carry no useful information over fingerprints and descriptors. They do seem to add some value relative to using the fingerprint in isolation, at least for the Tox21 and QM7 tasks. Whereas MoleculeACE, HIV, and BACE all can be well predicted with fingerprints alone, even descriptors adding little value here, the other three remaining tasks benefit from adding descriptors substantially. This is consistent with the view that CLIMB embeddings mostly supply physico-chemical information when pretrained on descriptors in addition to being good structure encoders by default.
blocks.zh: 为了了解我们的CLIMB嵌入是否包含任何与指纹和描述符相关的补充信息,我们测试了与使用指纹,描述符或者两者的组合相比,我们嵌入符在性能上增加了什么. 所有组合被输入到相同的XGBooost预测头,并有5倍的交叉验证. 图5显示,CMIMB嵌入对这些下游任务一般没有多大帮助. 在任何情况下,加入CLIMB嵌入物都会比指纹+描述符提高性能,说明CLIMB嵌入物不会携带任何有用的信息比指纹和描述符更有用. 它们似乎比单独使用指纹增加了一些价值,至少对Tox21和QM7任务来说是如此。 尽管分子ACE、HIV和BACE都能够仅凭指纹就得到很好的预测,即使描述词在这里没有多大价值,但其余的三项任务都得益于大量添加描述词。 这符合以下观点,即CLIMB嵌入在预训于描述器时,除了默认是良好的结构编码器外,大部分还提供物理化学信息.

blocks.en: Alternatively, these embeddings might simply help by providing a smooth molecular representation, contrary to the sparse, discrete ECFPs, which are useful for predicting smooth tasks like Tox21 and QM7. At least on the QM7 task, the random encoder is as useful as the unsupervised CLIMB model. Why this would be the case for one classification task, Tox21, but not another, BACE, is unclear however. Overall, we find that CLIMB embeddings carry no useful additional information for molecular property prediction. We do find that the supervised CLIMB embeddings are better than the unsupervised embedding as well as ECFP at predicting descriptors, see Section D in the SI. Evidently, they do carry some information on the physico-chemical properties of a molecule beyond what is in the fingerprint alone.
blocks.zh: 或者,这些嵌入可能只是通过提供平滑的分子代表来帮助,与稀疏,离散的ECFP相反,ECFP对于预测像Tox21和QM7这样的平滑任务是有用的. 至少在QM7任务上,随机编码器和无监督的CLIMB模型一样有用. 然而,为何一个分类任务Tox21就属于这种情况,而另一个分类任务BACE则并非如此,这一点尚不清楚。 总的来说,我们发现CLIMB嵌入物没有为分子属性预测提供有用的额外信息. 我们确实发现,受监督的CMIMB嵌入比无监督的嵌入以及ECFP在预测描述符时更好,参见SI中的D节. 显然,它们携带了一些关于分子的物理化学性质的信息 超出了指纹的范畴。

blocks.en: Ultimately, to be successful at any molecular property prediction task, the embeddings used as input must resolve the differences in chemical structure relevant to a prediction. For example, inverting a stereocenter can destroy the activity of a drug as biology is homochiral. Similarly, activity cliffs are often dependent on adding a single functional group or a single-atom scaffold edit. If these changes are collapsed into indistinguishable embeddings already at the encoding step, no prediction head will ever successfully separate these molecules. We hence analyzed whether XGBoost models, which split data on at least one feature dimension, can resolve molecules that differ in only one isolated chemical edit. We report the Area Under the Curve (AUC) of the Receiver Operating Characteristic for the trained models, where 0.5 is equivalent to a random model, as well as an n-gram baseline, which simply counts SMILES characters and character pairs. We find that fingerprints alone already resolve nearly all cases, including stereochemistry, single-atom changes, and structural homologues, see Figure 6 . Adding descriptors resolves the one change fingerprints alone cannot detect: isotope substitution. The discrete nature of such fingerprints allows these molecules to be split along often only a few altered dimensions, lending itself naturally to the inductive bias of a model such as XGBoost [ 24 , 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 归根结底,要在任何分子属性预测任务上取得成功,用作输入的嵌入必须解决与预测相关的化学结构的差异. 例如,颠倒立体中心可以破坏药物的活性,因为生物学是同质的. 同样,活动悬崖也往往依赖于添加单个功能组或单原子脚手架编辑. 如果这些变化崩溃成无法分辨的嵌入物 已经在编码阶段,任何预测头都不会成功地分离这些分子。 因此,我们分析了XGBoost模型,该模型将至少一个特征维度的数据分割开来,是否能够解决仅在一个孤立的化学编辑中存在差异的分子. 我们为训练有素的模型报告接收器操作特征曲线下的区域(AUC),其中0.5等于随机模型,以及n克基线,仅计算SMILES字符和字符对. 包括立体化学、单原子变化、结构同位素, 添加描述符可以解决唯一的改变指纹无法检测:同位素替代. 这种指纹的离散性质使得这些分子往往只有几处改变的维度被分割开来,自然地放出了XGBoost[24,31]等模型的诱导偏差.

blocks.en: Figure 5: What information do CLIMB embeddings carry? CLIMB embeddings were appended to either fingerprints, descriptors, or both and combinations were used as input to an XGBoost model to isolate how much additional information our embeddings carry. We report the improvements in prediction performance, downstream lift, relative to the respective feature set named on the x-axis.
blocks.zh: 图5: CMIMB嵌入携带哪些信息? CMIMB嵌入物被附在指纹,描述符上,或者两者和组合都被用作XGBoost模型的输入,以隔离我们嵌入物携带的更多信息. 我们报告在预测性能、下游升力方面相对于在X轴上命名的特性集的改进情况。

blocks.en: We also find that CLIMB models generally do resolve most chemical edits with the exception of stereochemistry. However, they do so no better than a randomly initialized, untrained CLIMB model. By a Johnson–Lindenstrauss-type argument [ 32 ] , the untrained transformer block approximately acts as a random linear projection of the token count vector, which produces consistent displacements across different molecules. In fact, the random encoder manages to resolve stereochemistry, which involves a token-level change from @ to @@ , which the pretrained CLIMB models learn to ignore during the stereo-invariant pretraining. As expected, the random encoder fails to resolve molecules that have the same token set, as between a para- versus meta-substituted molecule. Similarly, pretraining on descriptors prevents the CLIMB model from resolving double-bond stereochemistry, which also does not change the physico-chemical properties of a molecule. All CLIMB models are capable of resolving isotope substitution of 12 C to 13 C, which changes one token explicitly from C to [13C] . This same sensitivity becomes a disadvantage when considering the same molecule written as different SMILES. Here, ECFP4 correctly uses identical embeddings, while different SMILES produce very different embeddings in the case of CLIMB models. This failure mode is not meaningfully reduced when pretraining on augmented SMILES. In this case, CLIMB embeddings struggle to correctly encode molecular invariances.
blocks.zh: 我们还发现,CMIMB模型一般确实解决了除立体化学以外的大多数化学编辑. 然而,它们所做的并不比随机初始化,未经训练的CLIMB模型更好. 根据约翰逊–林登斯特劳斯型的论证[32],未经过训练的变压器块大约起到对符号计数矢量的随机线性投影的作用,它在不同分子之间产生一致的偏移. 事实上,随机编码器管理解决立体化学,这涉及到一个符号级别从@到QQ的改变,预先训练的CMIMB模型在立体-变量预训中学习忽略这个变化. 如所料,随机编码器未能解析同位素集的分子,如第-段与元代分子之间. 同样,对描述符的预训也阻止了CLIMB模型解决双边立体化学,这也并不能改变分子的物理化学性质. 所有CLIMB模型都能够解决12 C到13 C的同位素替代,这明确将一个符号从C变为[13C]. 在考虑与不同的SMILES书写相同的分子时,这种相同的灵敏度会成为一种缺点. 在这里,ECFP4正确使用相同的嵌入,而不同的SMILES则在CLIMB模型中产生非常不同的嵌入. 在对增强的SMILES进行预训时,这种故障模式不会得到有意义的减少。 在这种情况下,CLIMB嵌入会为正确编码分子偏移而挣扎.

blocks.en: Surprisingly, pretraining seems to make models no better at encoding molecular structure in a way that a prediction head like XGBoost finds useful. These results suggest that CLMs encode the same amount of structural information as classical molecular features with the advantage of using fewer features (512 rather than 2,048 or 2,265 dimensions). The disadvantage of such a compressed embedding is that chemical edits are distributed across many dimensions, which can limit the effectiveness of tree-based prediction heads such as XGBoost [ 31 ] . We find that our pretrained CLMs resolve molecular structure no better than a random encoder and slightly worse than a fingerprint- and descriptor-based embedding.
blocks.zh: 令人惊讶的是,预训似乎使模型在编码分子结构方面没有更好的效果,就像XGBoost这样的预测头像发现有用. 这些结果表明,CLMs编码了与古典分子特征相同的结构信息,其优点是使用较少的特征(512比2,048或2,265维). 这种压缩嵌入的缺点是化学编辑分布在许多维度上,这可以限制XGBoost[31]等基于树的预测头的效果. 我们发现,我们预先训练的CLM解决分子结构的最好方法莫过于随机编码器,略低于指纹和描述符嵌入法.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Can representations resolve chemical edits? We tested ten chemical edits (1,000 molecule pairs each), where each parent is labeled 0 and every edited partner 1, giving 2,000 labeled vectors. An XGBoost model is tasked with predicting the labels. We report the area under the curve (AUC) of the receiver operating characteristic, where 0.5 would correspond to random predictions. Notation-only edits (SMILES enumeration, Kekulization) should score 0.5 0.5 .
blocks.zh: 图6: 说明能否解决化学编辑问题? 我们测试了10个化学编辑器(每个1,000分子对),其中每个母体被标注为0,每个编辑的伙伴1,给出2000个标注的矢量. XGBoost模型的任务是预测标签。 我们报告接收器操作特征曲线(AUC)下的区域,其中0.5对应随机预测. 仅标注编辑(SMILES cleasing, Kekulization)应得0.5分0.5.

blocks.en: 3 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 3. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We find that pretraining can improve downstream performance in CLMs. However, the worst pretraining settings underperform even a random encoding model and we find that the benefits of pretraining are quickly saturated and do not scale with more data. Only supervised pretraining on physico-chemical descriptors reliably delivered good downstream performance. We control for some possible confounding factors: (i.) we find no evidence that training our CLIMB models end-to-end on a downstream dataset improves performance (SI Figure E.1 ); (ii.) using XGBoost rather than MLP prediction heads for CLIMB models decreases performance slightly (SI Figure F.1 ), throughout the paper we report the MLP-based results; (iii.) we do not find that our models are bottlenecked by our specific choice of tokenizer or vocabulary size (SI Figure G.1 ); (iv.) we used unsupervised pretraining with both canonical and augmented SMILES and found no difference in downstream performance (SI Figure I.1 ) nor are these models meaningfully better at recognizing degenerate SMILES, see Figure 6 . Lastly, we also find no evidence for the often-repeated claim that pretrained models are better in a low-data regime. In fact, across baseline, pretrained, and end-to-end fine-tuned models the gaps in performance remain surprisingly static across dataset size, see SI Figure H.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们发现,预训可以改善下游的CLM性能. 然而,最糟糕的预训设置甚至连随机编码模型都表现不佳,我们发现预训的好处迅速饱和,没有用更多的数据进行规模化. 只有受监督的物理化学说明书预训才能可靠地在下游产生良好的性能。 我们控制着一些可能令人困惑的因素:(一) 我们发现没有证据表明,在下游数据集上对CMIMB模型进行端到端培训会提高性能(SI 图E.1);(二) 在报告基于MLP的结果的整个文件中,使用XGBoost而不是MLP预测头会使性能略有下降(SI 图F.1);(三) 我们发现我们的模型不会因我们具体选择的标语符号或词汇大小(SI 图G.1);(四) 我们使用了无监督的预训,对SMILES既具有犬科性又具有增强性能的SMILES没有区别(SI图I.1) 这些模型在识别退化的SMILES方面也没有更有意义的意义,见图6。 最后,我们也没有找到证据来证明经常重复的说法,即经过预先训练的模型在低数据制度中更好。 事实上,跨基线、预先培训、端到端微调模型的性能差距在数据集大小之间仍然令人惊讶地保持静态,见SI图H.1。

blocks.en: It seems that supervised pretraining is most successful precisely because it teaches physico-chemical properties. The CLIMB embeddings resulting from supervised descriptor pretraining seem to contain similar information content to descriptors, see Figure 5 , and indeed descriptors can be easily reconstructed from these embeddings, see SI Table D.1 . The evidence in the case of unsupervised pretraining seems to hint at models learning low-level statistics that can be useful in some prediction tasks. However, these improvements can even be observed when training on non-chemical corpora, in our case English-language Wikipedia articles. While models unambiguously improve over an untrained encoder, we remain unconvinced that much real chemistry is being learned. We find no evidence that CLMs learn any chemical intuition beyond structural representation and physico-chemical properties that, alternatively, could also have been computed exactly. Under all settings evaluated, classical encodings outperform pretrained models while obviating the need for computationally intensive pretraining.
blocks.zh: 监督的预训似乎最成功,因为它教授物理化学特性。 受监督的描述符前缀培训产生的CMIMB嵌入似乎包含与描述符类似的信息内容,见图5,事实上描述符可以很容易地从这些嵌入符中重建,见SI表D.1. 未经监督的预训中的证据似乎暗示模型学习低级统计,在某些预测任务中可能有用. 然而,这些改进甚至可以在关于非化学公司的培训中观察到,在我们的例子中,英语维基百科的文章. 虽然模型在未经训练的编码器上得到了毫不含糊的改进,但我们仍然不相信正在学习许多真正的化学。 我们没有发现证据表明,氯化石解在结构性能和物理化学特性之外,还学会了任何化学直觉,而这些化学直觉也可以准确地计算出来。 在所有评价的设置下,古典编码超越了预先训练的模型,同时不需要计算密集的预训练.

blocks.en: Our conclusions are restricted to the 41.4M-parameter, encoder-only CLIMB architecture and the supervised and unsupervised objectives studied here. Our conclusions may not extend to other CLM architectures, such as decoder-only or encoder–decoder transformers, and do not necessarily generalize to different architectures such as GNNs. It is conceivable that the true benefits of pretraining may only arise when using much larger models, substantially larger datasets, alternative objectives, or using very different architectures. In particular, we do not consider reaction prediction as a pretraining task [ 33 ] nor domain-specific objectives [ 34 , 35 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们的结论仅限于41.4M参数,只有编码器的CLIMB架构以及在这里研究的受监督和不受监督的目标. 我们的结论可能不会延伸到其他的 CLM 架构,例如只解码器或编码器–解码器变压器,也不一定泛指GNNs等不同的架构. 可以想象,只有在使用更大的模型、大得多的数据集、替代目标或使用非常不同的结构时,才会产生预训的真正好处。 特别是,我们不认为反应预测是一项预先训练的任务[33]或特定领域的目标[34,35]。

blocks.en: Here, in addition to an extended methods section, we report a number of results on potentially confounding factors regarding our downstream evaluation such as the choice of prediction head, tokenizer and vocabulary size, and use of augmented or canonical SMILES during pretraining. We also test whether end-to-end training, from either a pretrained checkpoint or from scratch, can yield better downstream performance.

blocks.en: A.1 Model architecture
blocks.zh: A.1 示范结构

blocks.en:
All CLIMB encoders follow the same architecture: a 12-layer ModernBERT-style bidirectional transformer with 41.4M parameters. Alternating local and global attention (a 128-token sliding window, with full attention every third
layer) keeps the cost linear in sequence length while preserving long-range structure. The tokenizer uses byte-pair encoding (BPE) with a 1,000-token vocabulary fit on a 10M-molecule sample of the filtered PubChem corpus, and it is held fixed across all runs in the paper, including those pretrained on the larger corpus.

层)保持成本线性序列长度,同时保留远程结构. 示意剂使用字节-pair编码(BPE),其1000个托肯词汇适合过滤的PubChemule样本,它被固定在纸上所有各行各业,包括那些在大体上预先训练的词汇。

We refer to models based on the number of unique molecules seen during pretraining (either 8M or 100M). Pretraining runs are measured in individual tokens. Downstream, the encoder is frozen and only a small probe head is trained (Section A.3 ).

The descriptor objective (multi-task regression, MTR) regresses 217 precomputed RDKit [ 25 ] descriptors. These are deterministic functions of structure rather than measured labels. The assay
objective is multi-task supervised learning on real measured labels drawn from four public panels,
following the MiniMol LargeMix selection [ 27 , 26 ] . In certain pretraining settings, multiple objectives are run sequentially or interleaved where data of two sources is combined and the objective is chosen based on which training data is sampled at each step.

blocks.en: Appendix B Resolving power of embeddings
blocks.zh: 附录B 嵌入的溶解力

blocks.en: Figure 6 attempts to quantify how well different embeddings can distinguish molecules that are globally similar but differ in one chemical edit (e.g. stereoinversion). We first curated a pool of unique, RDKit-canonicalized molecules from the benchmark datasets (30 MoleculeACE ChEMBL targets, BACE and Tox21). From this we generated 1,000 matched molecule pairs for each of ten structural edits, together with two notation-only controls (SMILES re-enumeration and Kekulization) in which the string changes but the molecule does not. Structural edits were compared as canonical SMILES, so that the only string difference is the one the edit forces. For each representation and each edit, every parent molecule was labeled 0 and its edited partner 1, giving 2,000 labeled vectors, and a gradient-boosted tree classifier (XGBoost; 200 trees, maximum depth 4, learning rate 0.3) was trained to separate the classes. Because molecules recur across pairs, pairs sharing a molecule were merged into connected components by union such that no test molecule appears in training. 20% of pairs were held out, and we report the mean held-out ROC-AUC over five split seeds ( ± \pm 1 s.d.). As a baseline, we use the character 1- and 2-grams of the representative SMILES string and also pass it through the XGBoost model.
blocks.zh: 图6试图量化不同嵌入法如何能区分全球相似但在一个化学编辑中有所不同的分子(如立体反演). 我们首先从基准数据集(30MoleculeACE ChEMBL目标、BACE和Tox21)中整理了一组独特的RDKit卡农化分子。 由此我们产生了1000对匹配的分子对,每个10个结构编辑,加上两个只标注的控件(SMILES re-ennuction and Kekulization),在这两个控件中,字符串会改变但分子不会改变. 结构编辑被比作canonical SMILES,这样唯一的字符串差异就是编辑力. 每个表示和编辑时,每个母分子都标注为0,其编辑的伙伴1,给出2000个标注的矢量,并训练了一个梯度催化树分类器(XGBoost;200棵树,最大深度4,学习速率0.3)来分班. 由于分子跨对重现,共享一个分子的对子通过结合被合并成连接的元件,这样在训练中就不会出现测试分子. 20%的对子被牵出,我们报告在5个分裂种子(±\pm 1 s.d.)上的平均牵出ROC-AUC. 作为基线,我们使用代表性的SMILES字符串的字符1-和2克,也通过XGBoost模型传递.

blocks.en: To better understand the absolute performance of our models rather than just reporting relative rankings as in Figure 1 , we display the absolute errors across the four main categories of tasks these models were evaluated on, see Figure C.1 . We find that the best XGBoost model is particularly dominant on activity cliffs and regression, while performance differences are not distinguishable from noise for classification and virtual screening. Nonetheless, XGBoost on fingerprints+descriptors is by far the most competitive, robust, and generalizable prediction method across deployment settings examined.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地了解我们的模型的绝对性能,而不是像图1那样只报告相对的排名,我们显示了这些模型在评价的四个主要任务类别中的绝对错误,见图C.1。 我们发现,最好的XGBoost模型在活动悬崖和回归上尤其占据主导地位,而性能差异则与用于分类和虚拟筛选的噪音无法区分. 尽管如此,指纹+描述符上的XGBoost是迄今所检查的部署环境中最具竞争力、最有力和最通用的预测方法。

blocks.en: Appendix D Reconstruction of descriptors from CLIMB embeddings
blocks.zh: 附录D 重构CPIMB嵌入式描述符

blocks.en: To evaluate if supervised pretraining on descriptors actually results in the CLIMB model learning to reorder its latent space according to these physico-chemical properties we tried predicting these descriptors from the embeddings. We compare this to predicting descriptors from ECFPs, the CLIMB unsupervised embeddings, and a randomly initialized CLIMB model. We use a ridge regression head on all embeddings.
blocks.zh: 为了评估对描述符的有监督的预训是否真的导致CLIMB模型学习根据这些物理化学特性重新排列其潜在空间,我们试图从嵌入物中预测这些描述符。 我们比较了这一点来预测ECFPs的描述符,CLIMB无监督的嵌入符,以及随机初始化的CLIMB模型. 我们在所有嵌入物上都使用一个脊折头.

blocks.en: Overall, these results confirmed our underlying hypothesis that a CLIMB model is able to learn descriptor chemistry, its median R 2 R^{2} value is by far the highest and actually beats the other embeddings on every individual descriptor recorded, see Table D.1 . Overall, the fingerprint embedding does beat the unsupervised CLIMB embedding, although the unsupervised CLIMB embeddings are markedly better at recovering topological and shape descriptors. The unsupervised embeddings are also substantially better at predicting descriptors than a randomly initialized model, suggesting that even unsupervised pretraining CLIMB embeddings do retain some meaningful molecular information, presumably the ability to cluster similar structures closer together.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果证实了我们的基本假设,即CMIMB模型能够学习描述化学,其中位值R 2 R^{2}是迄今为止最高的,实际上比记录到的每个单个描述物上的其他嵌入值要好,见表D.1。 总的来说,指纹嵌入确实比无监督的CLIMB嵌入要好,尽管无监督的CLIMB嵌入在恢复地形和形状描述符方面明显更好. 未经监督的嵌入物在预测描述词方面也比随机初始化模型要好得多,这表明即使未经监督的预训CLIMB嵌入物也确实保留了一些有意义的分子信息,大概是将类似结构更紧密地组合在一起的能力.

blocks.en: Appendix E Deploying pretrained models end-to-end does not improve downstream performance
blocks.zh: 部署经过预先培训的模型端到端不会改善下游的业绩

blocks.en: We mostly evaluated our CLIMB models in a frozen encoder setting, where we only train the prediction head on the downstream task. To see if this is also a major bottleneck for our CLIMB models we chose the best supervised model trained on descriptors and the model pretrained on unlabeled data only and compared their performance in both a frozen encoder and end-to-end setting. We find that training end-to-end, which involves significantly more compute, can have positive effects in some larger datasets, namely the HIV virtual screening and the Tox21 dataset, but overall only equates to a marginal advantage, never beating the best XGBoost baseline methods. End-to-end is ahead in 12 of 18 cells tested, but differences are not meaningfully resolved at this test set size, we report six of these in Figure E.1 . The CLIMB models do not substantially benefit from end-to-end fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们大多在冷冻编码器的环境下评估了CLIMB模型, 在那里我们只对下游任务的预测头进行训练。 为了了解这是否也是我们CLIMB模型的一个主要瓶颈,我们选择了接受过描述器培训的最佳监督模型,模型只接受过无标签数据的预先培训,并在冷冻编码器和端到端设置中比较它们的性能. 我们发现,培训的端到端,涉及的计算量要大得多,可以在一些更大的数据集,即艾滋病毒虚拟筛选和Tox21数据集中产生积极效果,但总体而言,这只能等同于边际优势,永远不能击败最好的XGBoost基线方法. 在经过测试的18个电池中,有12个电池的端对端领先,但在这个测试设定大小上,差异没有得到有意义的解决,我们在图E.1中报告了其中6个。 CMIMB模型没有从端到端的微调中获取实质性好处.

blocks.zh: 附录F 下游性能不受预测头的瓶颈

blocks.en: To control for the use of prediction head, we also evaluated two of our CLIMB models (supervised, descriptor and unsupervised) using both their default MLP head as well as XGBoost, see Figure F.1 . We find no systematic benefit in using XGBoost on CLIMB embeddings and the MLP is the better choice on average. This makes some intuitive sense as XGBoost splits the dataset on specific features which is easier with discrete, mostly orthogonal dimensions in a fingerprint rather than a continuous embedding where molecular changes are mixed across many dimensions. It speaks to the robustness of XGBoost that it is able to remain competitive at all with an MLP head even using CLIMB embeddings.
blocks.zh: 为了控制预测头的使用,我们还评估了我们的两个CLIMB模型(监督、描述和无监督),使用它们默认的MLP头和XGBoost,见图F.1。 我们发现在CMIMB嵌入物上使用XGBoost没有系统性的好处,平均来说,MLP是更好的选择. 这使得一些直观感,因为XGBoost将关于特定特征的数据集分割开来,这些特征比较容易在指纹中与离散的,多为正向维度,而不是在许多维度中分子变化混合的连续嵌入. 这说明XGBoost的强性,它甚至可以使用CLIMB嵌入的MLP头保持竞争力.

No discernible effect on downstream performance is found.

blocks.en: We keep CLIMB’s underlying architecture constant across all experiments unless otherwise stated. One potential confounding factor we were interested in was the vocabulary size and choice of tokenizer. No general consensus exists on the optimal architecture for CLMs and a number of different tokenizers have been used [ 48 ] . The two tokenizers work in opposite directions: BPE starts with basic characters, finding the most common pairs and merging them until the target vocabulary size is reached; Unigram-LM starts from all possible subwords, computes token probabilities, dropping tokens that lower the loss least until the target vocabulary size is reached.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明, 我们感兴趣的一个潜在的困惑因素是 词汇大小和符号的选择。 对于CLM的最佳架构没有普遍共识,使用了一些不同的标语符号[48]. 两种示意剂是相反方向的: BPE从基本字符开始,找到最常用的对并合并,直到达到目标词汇大小;Unigram-LM从所有可能的子词开始,计算符号概率,放下降低损失最小的符号直到达到目标词汇大小.

blocks.en: Both of these tokenizers need to be briefly pretrained themselves to learn the tokens on a representative corpus. We pretrain both tokenizers on the same corpus and aim for similar vocabulary sizes, although the exact vocabulary reached varies across them. We then use the resulting tokenizers in the same unsupervised-only pretrained CLIMB model which we evaluate on the six tasks shown in Figure G.1 . Reassuringly we find that CLIMB’s performance is essentially independent of both tokenizer and vocabulary size choice. If anything, larger vocabulary sizes seem to hurt performance for the BPE tokenizer although most differences are well within the noise of the five cross-validation folds. This largely agrees with prior work finding that tokenization has only a limited effect on downstream property prediction [ 49 , 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 这两个标语符号都需要经过短暂的预先训练,才能在代表体上学习标语. 我们先将标语标注在同一个体上,然后针对相似的词汇大小,尽管所达到的确切词汇在它们之间有所不同. 然后,我们用同样的无监督的、只经过预先训练的CMIMB模型,来评估图G.1所示的六项任务。 我们确信CLIMB的性能基本上独立于标语和词汇大小选择。 如果有的话,更大的词汇大小似乎会损害BPE的标致器的性能,尽管大多数差异完全在五个交叉验证折叠的噪声之内. 这基本上同意先前的工作结论,即象征性化对下游地产预测的影响有限[49,50].

blocks.en: Appendix H Downstream performance as a function of downstream dataset size
blocks.zh: 附录H 下游数据集大小的函数

blocks.en: We had seen some evidence that fine-tuning a randomly initialized CLIMB model only on downstream data, i.e. no pretraining, can be competitive on large datasets. We were thus curious to test whether there exists a clear intersection point in terms of dataset size where training end-to-end becomes competitive with a pretrained CLIMB model. By downsampling the same dataset, we benchmark the supervised, descriptor and unsupervised-only CLIMB model against the end-to-end versions of CLIMB. We find that if a gap in performance exists, it is essentially stable across dataset size and that our initial hypothesis that end-to-end training without pretraining becomes increasingly competitive as downstream datasets grow in size could not be confirmed.
blocks.zh: 我们看到一些证据表明,仅在下游数据上对随机初始化的CMIMB模型进行微调,即没有预训,在大型数据集上可以具有竞争力。 因此,我们很想知道,在数据集的大小方面是否存在一个明确的交叉点,即培训端到端会与预先训练的CMIMB模型竞争。 通过对同一数据集进行下取样,我们对照CLIMB的端到端版本,将受监督,描述器和无监督的CLIMB模型作为基准. 我们发现,如果存在性能差距,那么整个数据集的规模基本稳定,我们最初的假设是,随着下游数据集规模的扩大,没有预先培训的端到端培训越来越具有竞争力。

blocks.en: Appendix I Using canonical versus augmented SMILES in unsupervised pretraining does not impact downstream performance
blocks.zh: 在无监督的预训中使用犬科和强化的SMILES不影响下游的绩效

blocks.en: The use of SMILES enumeration for data augmentation is an established technique in CLMs [ 51 ] . Nonetheless, we were curious to test whether enumeration generalizes better than exact repetition in the multi-epoch regime. We thus compared presenting each molecule in its exact canonical form (repetition) against fresh on-the-fly RDKit SMILES enumeration while doing multiple epochs over a ≈ \approx 12 M-molecule corpus.
blocks.zh: 使用SMILES计数进行数据扩充是CLMs[51]中的一种既定技术. 然而,我们很想知道,在多时代制度下,列举是否比确切的重复更普遍。 因此,我们比较了每个分子在飞行上新鲜的RDKit SMILES计数时,以准确的犬形形式(重复)呈现出来,同时在一个大约12 M-分子体上做多个历程。

blocks.en: We find no strong differences in performance although the augmented pretraining procedure edges out a win in MoleculeACE and Tox21, see Figure I.1 . In absolute terms, the difference in performance is relatively minor and the augmented model is only slightly more robust towards non-canonical input SMILES, see also Figure 6 . In summary, pretraining on augmented SMILES is certainly the safer choice and may have small benefits on certain datasets, although downstream performance is much more sensitive towards the choice of pretraining objective and dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们发现在性能上没有强烈的差别,不过增加的预训程序在MoleculeACE和Tox21中胜出,见图一.1。 就绝对值而言,性能的差别相对较小,扩大型号对非冠状输入的SMILES只略强一些,另见图6。 简言之,关于扩充的SMILES的预训无疑是比较安全的选择,对某些数据集可能好处不大,不过下游的成绩对预训目标和数据集的选择更为敏感。

blocks.en: Appendix J Controlling for weight-conditioning in unsupervised pretraining
blocks.zh: 附录J 在无监督的预训中控制重量调节

blocks.en: The results in Figure 4 b in the main text establish that the benefits of unsupervised pretraining can largely be recovered even by training on corrupted SMILES. To distinguish the effects of learning generalizable features from optimization and improved initialization, we ran a control experiment [ 52 , 53 , 54 , cf.] . We opted to construct control models that appear numerically similar to a trained model while not having undergone any training. We achieve this either simply by resampling each weight matrix from its own per-tensor mean and variance; or by randomly permuting matrix entries. The LayerNorm values are copied verbatim from the trained model. Table J.1 reports the decomposition.
blocks.zh: 主文图4b的结果显示,即使对腐败的SMILES进行培训,也在很大程度上可以收回未经监督的预训的好处。 为了区分学习一般特征的效果与优化和改进初始化的效果,我们进行了控制实验[52,53,54,参考.]. 我们选择建造与训练有素的模型在数量上相似的控制模型,但没有经过任何培训。 我们要么简单地通过从自身每分数的平均值和差异中重新模拟每个重量矩阵,要么通过随机渗透矩阵条目来实现这一点。 TyleNorm 值从训练过的模型中逐字复制 。 表J.1报告分解情况。

blocks.en: Three mechanisms are separable, and their relative sizes are task-dependent: On QM7 for example, the control reproduces the full effect (2.74 of 2.86 for the real corpus, 3.12 of 2.84 for Wikipedia). The apparent pretraining benefits on this task seemingly come down to better weight initialization and no learned chemistry. On MoleculeACE and HIV conditioning accounts for only 13–24%, and a corpus containing no chemistry supplies 75–81% of what real SMILES supplies, suggesting that for these tasks low-level corpus statistics are most useful. On BACE, Tox21 and Ames the ordering reverses: 81–138% of the improvements only derive from real SMILES, and on Ames a non-chemical corpus is actively harmful. These tasks seemingly require true, chemically correct and representative token sets. Future work is needed to better understand what type of pretraining information is most useful for which type of task in unsupervised pretraining.
blocks.zh: 三种机制是分开的,它们的相对规模取决于任务: 例如在QM7上,控制复制了全效(2.86的2.74对真体,2.84的3.12对维基百科). 对这项任务的明显预先训练的好处似乎归根结底是提高初始化的重量,而没有学到任何化学知识。 在MoleculeACE和HIV调制中,只有13–24 %,一个没有化学物质的体积提供了75–81 %的SMILES真正供给,这表明低水平体积统计对于这些任务最为有用。 在BACE、Tox21和Ames的订单倒置中:81-138 %的改进只来自真实的SMILES,在Ames的改进中,非化学体是有害的。 这些任务似乎需要真实、化学正确和具有代表性的标志。 今后需要开展工作,以更好地了解何种类型的培训前信息对无监督的预训中哪类任务最为有用。
